Title: Staged deployments on Azure Web Sites

Body.Content: Set up staged publishing by creating multiple site slots for Standard mode websites. A staging site slot is created for each default production site, and you can swap slots with no downtime. See Staged Publishing on Azure Web Sites to learn more.
